tips.text: Use () to describe actions, feelings, and thoughts to make the chat more immersive.
Try adjusting “Chat Style” in chat settings to change the tone or writing style.
Tap the heart icon on an iMate to save them to Favorites for quick access.
Earn Credits by chatting, generating images, listening to voices, or checking in daily, then use them to hype an iMate.
Tap the + button to access voice call and have real-time conversations with your iMates.
When reporting issues, upload a screenshot to help us understand and fix the problem faster.
Need help? Chat with IntelliMate to report issues, share feedback, request features, or get tips on using the app.
Tap + in the input box, then tap Reset in the drop-down menu, to reset chat.
